nodes.title: Note: MiniMax H3
widgets_values:
## MiniMax H3 - Audio Lip Sync (updated 11-19-26)

[MiniMax H3](https://www.minimax.io/blog/minimax-h3) is MiniMax's open omni-modal model that makes video and sound together. This workflow turns **one photo + one audio track** into a video of that person singing or talking, with the mouth following your audio. It uses the **ref2va** model, which holds the face from your photo better than the standard fl2va build.

## What's new in this version

- **Faster:** ref2v 4-step turbo LoRA + **Fast Gate** (VSA sparse attention gate), 4 steps, er_sde + sgm_uniform, about 2x faster sampling than the old version.
- **Your Audio (on/off):** on = lip sync to your track. Off = no audio file needed, H3 makes the voice and sound itself from your prompt.
- **Refine pass (off by default):** upscales the video inside the model (Refine size, default 1.3x) and repaints it lightly (Refine strength) with your audio locked. Sharper teeth, skin and hair, about 2x the time. On a 20 GB card keep refine clips to about 10 s (a 12 s clip ran out of memory).
- **RTX upscale to 1080p:** the second output scales the short side to 1080 for any aspect.

Switch the groups in the **Fast Groups Muter**.

## Key inputs

- **Load Image:** a clear, front-facing photo works best.
- **Load Audio (Upload):** clean vocals with little background noise give the best lip sync.
- **Resolution Selector:** match the aspect ratio to your photo; 0.6 MP is the default (turn on the Refine pass for more detail).
- **duration:** set it to your audio length (H3 snaps to its 17-frame grid at 24 fps).
- **prompt:** who is in the picture and what they are doing (singing on a stage, talking to the camera).

## Tips

- Keep **sage_attention disabled** on the model loader: Fast Gate replaces the attention and won't stack with Sage.
- 12 GB cards run at full speed but lean on system RAM: 32 GB or more recommended.
- The old version (Spectrum, EasyCache, Sage, 6 steps) is still in the original post if you want it.

## Custom Nodes

[KJNodes](https://github.com/kijai/ComfyUI-KJNodes) · [rgthree](https://github.com/rgthree/rgthree-comfy) · [VideoHelperSuite](https://github.com/Kosinkadink/ComfyUI-VideoHelperSuite) · [Ref2VA-VSA (Fast Gate)](https://github.com/Kablex/ComfyUI-Ref2VA-VSA) · [Minimax H3 Latent Upscaler](https://github.com/LBH-123-AI/Comfyui_Minimax_h3_latent_Upscaler) · [Memory Cleanup](https://github.com/LAOGOU-666/Comfyui-Memory_Cleanup) · [Nvidia RTX Nodes](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/Nvidia_RTX_Nodes_ComfyUI). Install missing ones with ComfyUI Manager.

## Report Issue

Note: Please update ComfyUI first ([guide](https://docs.comfy.org/installation/update_comfyui)) and prepare required models. Desktop/Cloud updates follow stable releases, so some nightly-supported models may not be available yet.

- Cannot run / runtime errors: [ComfyUI/issues](https://github.com/comfyanonymous/ComfyUI/issues)
- UI / frontend issues: [ComfyUI_frontend/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI_frontend/issues)
- Workflow issues: [workflow_templates/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/issues)

Vaporwave title sequence look: pink and blue gradient palette, VHS tracking artifacts, Greek statue motifs, chrome palm trees, RGB chromatic aberration, lo-fi retro atmosphere, mood languid and nostalgic.

Timeline:
[0s-1s] VHS static opens the frame, the title "COMFYUI" appears with RGB split and a slight horizontal jitter.
[1s-2.5s] Hard cut, a Greek plaster bust close-up, pink-purple gradient sky, a pixelated sun.
[2.5s-4s] Clean "STARRING" credits appear, "LATENT" and "CONTROLNET" each shown exactly once.
[4s-5s] Final card "DIRECTED BY COMFYUI" holds, one VHS tracking glitch settling into stability.

Hard cuts only, transitions landing with tape jumps, no push-ins, no dissolves.

Audio: lo-fi vaporwave score, slow drum machine with soft bass, VHS tape-noise sample joins at 2.5s, melody fading for the last 1s.

All text must be clearly legible, do not misspell English, no Chinese characters, do not repeat names or job titles, no soft dissolves, no subtitle bars.
